title: Notifications & visible updates
summary: ACS Truck now tells users when the app changes and when operational events need their attention.
changes: New notification bell with unread counts and a role-aware notification inbox.
Drivers receive delivery assignment and delivery-status alerts relevant to them.
Accounts receive delivery-completion, payment, income and expense alerts that need financial attention.
Operations and Admin receive delivery and maintenance operational alerts.
Access or role changes notify the affected user.
PWA updates now ask Update now or Later instead of activating silently.
Users can review What changed before applying an update.
Optional browser alerts are available while ACS Truck is running in the browser or installed PWA.
